title: Curiosity
text: I like understanding how things work under the hood. If a tool does something surprising, I go read its source.

title: Building
text: Turning an idea into something real is what keeps me going. Small tools, big projects — I enjoy the whole loop.

title: Sharing
text: Writing things down and teaching others is how I make sense of what I learn. A good explanation is a gift to your future self.

title: Challenges
text: Hard problems are the fun ones. I'd rather spend an evening debugging than a morning doing busywork.
